# Asia Chip Supply Tightens, Prices Keep Rising  
**Bottom line:** Expect tighter lead times and higher pricing; lock in volume discounts where advised, but defer non‑critical buys.

## What changed
- Market‑wide supply risk nudged up to **70.9** (+0.1) and price trend stayed high at **84.6** (‑0.1) [1][2].  
- TSMC foundry loading surged +50.9% YoY, pushing supply risk higher [3].  
- Korea’s chip export volume jumped +171% YoY in early Oct, reinforcing both supply strain and price pressure [4].  
- Semiconductor PPI rose +9.1% annualized over the last three months, feeding tighter supply and higher prices [1].  
- Global chip sales hit **$159.7 B** in Aug 2026, a **+146.1% YoY** surge, amplifying demand‑side pressure [2].

## Featured part: IPB017N10N5ATMA1
- Lead time **14 weeks**; channel stock **27,211** units (≈ 17.7 weeks of supply).  
- No on‑order quantity (PBO) reported; next arrival date not set.  
- Price **$5.56** for qty 1, **$2.51** for 1 k units.  
- Origin **Austria**, tariff **0 %** (no surcharge).  
- Buy‑timing call: **Lock pricing (no need to buy ahead)** – 65 % chance prices rise in 3 months, but supply is adequate [source].

## Alerts  

*(none)*  

## Segment board
- Processors & advanced logic – supply **70.3** (↑0.1), price **79.0**, confidence **High**.  
- Memory (DRAM/NAND/HBM) – supply **72.8** (↑0.1), price **84.7**, confidence **High**.

## Your BOM watchlist
- **10M08SAE144C8G** – lead time **52 weeks** vs 12‑week norm, price +129 % vs target.

All are flagged by extreme factory lead times, driving supply‑risk scores of **83.2**.

## Outlook
- **Chip prices, next 3 months:** 66 % probability of rise; expected **+2.17 %** (80 % range ‑9.57 % to +13.91 %); model‑based edge tested [forecast 1].  
- **Chip prices, next 6 months:** 52 % probability of rise; expected **+4.34 %** (‑8.79 % to +17.46 %); trend‑following baseline [forecast 2].
